item.title: Stanford Finds All 8 LLMs Favor Their Own Medical Answers as Judges
item.description:
A new Stanford paper had eight models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Qwen answer 620 real clinician questions, then rank all eight answers anonymously. Every judge favored its own answer, by 1.22 rank positions on average and nearly 3 for GPT-5.6 Sol. The bias persisted without a rubric, and revealing model names cut it by only 0.094 positions, implying LLM-as-judge medical benchmarks carry systematic self-preference. The authors recommend multi-family judge panels with per-judge reporting instead of one pooled score.

原文标题：斯坦福发现 8 款大模型评审医学答案时集体偏袒自身

Why it matters：直接动摇 LLM-as-judge 评测范式的可信度，对做医学评测与模型选型的人有立即可用的方法论修正。

item.title: Tencent Open-Sources Hy4 flash with 224B Total Parameters
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced the Hy4 flash family, including the standard, FP8, and Base variants, available on GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode. The model carries 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) while activating only 12B per token, supports multimodal input and a 1M-token context window, and is positioned as the most cost-effective Hy model to date, already deployed across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Yuanbao, WeCom, and other products. Tencent also teased that the full Hy4 model is being open-sourced soon.

原文标题：腾讯开源 Hy4 flash 模型 224B 总参数激活 12B

Why it matters：国产大厂稀疏激活旗舰模型开源，参数规模与百万上下文规格明确，可直接下载部署。

item.title: Two AI Models Build Explorable Miami 3D Scene From Single Prompt
item.description:
Artificial Analysis prompted Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra, each with a single prompt in the offline AA-3D sandbox, to build a GTA VI-themed Miami scene. Both models populated Ocean Drive with real hotels the prompt never named, including the Colony and the Avalon, and produced scenes explorable by car, speedboat or blimp at sunset or night. The test highlights implicit spatial memory of real cities and interactive 3D generation in frontier models without internet access.

原文标题：两大模型单提示词生成可探索迈阿密 3D 场景

Why it matters：以对照实验方式展示两大前沿模型在离线条件下生成可交互真实城市 3D 场景的能力，具备直观的技术参考价值。

item.title: Rockchip RK3668 Specs Leak with 44 TOPS NPU and 2027 Sampling
item.description:

Aimed at edge AI and multimedia devices, engineering samples are slated for Q1 2027, making this a relatively long-range roadmap disclosure.

item.title: US Commerce Tightens AI Chip Exports to Five Nations Requiring Licenses
item.description:

The rule sets a 12 million total processing performance threshold (roughly 760 Nvidia H100s) to close the loophole used by China-headquartered firms, sending AMD and CoreWeave shares down about 5%.

item.title: iFixit Teardown Finds Apple HomeView Hard to Repair in Both Versions
item.description:
iFixit tore down Apple's first smart home hub, HomeView, revealing differences between the desktop and wall-mounted versions: the desktop model has a larger rear speaker and a built-in subwoofer in its base, while the wall version uses a smaller speaker and a more sealed chassis. Both are held together by heavy glue and thermal adhesive with very short cables, making the display, speakers and logic board nearly impossible to remove without damage, and the A18 chip, 8GB RAM and 64GB NAND are soldered directly to the board.

原文标题：iFixit 拆解苹果 HomeView 两款版本均难维修

Why it matters：首款苹果智能家居中枢的硬件拆解首次披露内部结构与可维修性，对关注端侧 AI 硬件形态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: AMD Completes Taalas Acquisition to Fold Inference ASIC Into Accelerator Roadmap

item.title: Anthropic Tests Linked Billing for Third-Party Claude Apps
item.description:
Anthropic launched a beta OAuth feature called Linked Billing on the Claude platform, letting third-party AI apps bind a customer's Claude organization so the customer pays directly for the API calls they generate. The mechanism replaces shared API keys, with users able to view costs, set monthly caps and unlink anytime, capped at $50 during beta. For small AI app teams, it could reshape the prepay-then-resell business model.

item.title: Google Signs $500M Geothermal Power Deal for 50MW from 2030
item.description:
Google has signed a power purchase agreement worth over $500 million with deep geothermal startup Quaise Energy to supply 50MW of clean electricity to its Oregon data center starting in 2030. Quaise uses millimeter-wave drilling to reach depths of 3-20km and temperatures of 300-500°C, yielding up to 10x the energy output of conventional geothermal wells. The deal marks another landmark move by a tech giant to lock in long-term baseload clean power amid AI-driven compute expansion.
